title: Train a Reasoning Model with GRPO
blurb: Build Group Relative Policy Optimization: group-relative advantages, KL to the reference, the clipped loss, length normalisation and pass@k.
intro: GRPO trains reasoning models with verifiable rewards by sampling a group of answers per prompt and scoring each against its own group, so no value network is needed. The steps build group-relative advantages, the per-token KL estimate that keeps the policy near its starting point, the clipped GRPO loss, a comparison of length normalisations that exposes a bias towards long or short answers, and the unbiased pass@k estimator used to measure what training changed. The capstone runs a full GRPO update on a softmax answer policy and reports exact pass@1 and pass@k before and after.
